svg.title: Owners locate children by block number
svg.desc: Owner 42 lists child blocks 12 and 15. The reader visits those RECORD_BLOCKs and selects EVENT and STAGE records with parent 42, excluding LOG and records belonging to other owners.
svg.text: In each block, filter EVENT/STAGE by parent ID; skip LOG.
